resources.name: SIESTA
resources.notes: Open-source DFT code. Used for total energy, force, band structure, and elastic constant calculations within LDA with Troullier-Martins pseudopotentials.

resources.name: PHONON
resources.notes: Software by K. Parlinski for phonon dispersion and density of states via the direct method using Hellmann-Feynman forces. Compatible with SIESTA.
